center_uncertainty_note: Per coordinate (L-infinity), an empirical estimate under stated assumptions of the error in reading the figure: the largest offset found on TAP-2.5D's own placer panels from their 1 mm grid, plus the coordinate times the relative spread of the panel's three scale estimates, plus the 5e-5 mm storage step, rounded up to 1e-4 mm. It covers reading the figure only. It is not a figure-to-silicon error bound, and how faithfully the figure shows the authors' simulated layout cannot be read from it.

wire_note: routed_wirelength is this layout's routed wire W, from the open router (TAP-2.5D's MILP router ported from CPLEX to HiGHS), the wire figure the challenge judges. It depends only on the dies' relative positions: moving the whole layout leaves it unchanged. wire_proxy_mm is the proxy W_proxy, the connectivity-weighted mean Manhattan distance between die centres, a diagnostic that is never used to judge. Neither runs a thermal solve.
